note: a fresh container: a freshly installed CLI and nothing else
argv:
set -u
mkdir -p /home/agent/.codex-trial /home/agent/probe
cp /home/agent/.agent-auth/codex/auth.json /home/agent/.codex-trial/ 2>/dev/null || true
export CODEX_HOME=/home/agent/.codex-trial
cd /home/agent/probe
codex --version > /results/agent-version.txt 2>&1
codex exec --json --skip-git-repo-check --ephemeral --ignore-user-config   -s read-only -m gpt-5.6-sol -C /home/agent/probe   "$(cat /results/prompt.txt)"   > /results/transcript.jsonl 2> /results/stderr.log
echo $? > /results/exit-code.txt
